about: Tiers for tools/round_robin.py. Each tier plays a round robin; its last-placed bot is rated at the tier's floor and the others above it by their results, capped below the next tier's floor. Move a bot by moving its line. A bot that is not built here is listed at its tier's floor, as not played. A tier's "skip" lists bots that stay at their listed place without playing.

bots.Stardust2025: The original C++ Stardust as entered in AIIDE 2025, with trained mining; one of the strongest bots of recent AIIDE and SSCAIT years, and first in your old table (97% over 30 games)
bots.BananaBrain: AIIDE 2025 champion and long a top SSCAIT Protoss; 18-0 in your old table
bots.McRaveZ: McRave as entered in AIIDE 2024/2025, a top Zerg with strong late game; 20-0 in your old table
bots.Iron: Terran harassment bot, one of the strongest bots of 2016-2018; 18-1-1 in your old table
bots.SAIDA: AIIDE 2018 champion, Terran built to beat the bots of its time; 14-0 in your old table. Not committed (no licence): tools/fetch_bot.py SAIDA
bots.Locutus: Stardust's predecessor, a top Protoss of 2018-2019; 63% in your old table, the weakest record in this tier
bots.Microwave: Zerg on Steamhammer's base, a regular AIIDE entrant; 89% in your old table
bots.StardustPy: This repository's Python port of Stardust. No record in your old table; placed with the bot it ports, and it beat BananaBrain and Steamhammer in its first test games. The round robin will show whether it belongs here
bots.ClaudeOpus55: Its own bot, separate from the Python port: 73% over 577 games in your old table, between Iron and Locutus. Already rated elsewhere, so not played here
bots.Dragon: Terran, a strong SSCAIT bot of recent years; 89% in your old table. A recipe: tools/fetch_bot.py Dragon

bots.Steamhammer2025: Steamhammer 5.3.6 (AIIDE 2025): broad opening book, but only 76% in your old table, below every tier 1 bot
bots.Steamhammer: The older Steamhammer built into the test harness
bots.McRave: The older McRave built into the test harness
bots.CreativeZerg: Steamhammer 5.3.6 opening only with gambits: wins less, sometimes upsets stronger bots
bots.CreativeTerran: Steamhammer 5.3.6 playing Terran, the race it is weakest at, opening only with gambits
bots.WorkerRush: The example bot: attacks with its workers. 0 wins in your old table; the tier's floor marker
bots.WillyT: Terran; 78% in your old table, close to Steamhammer2025. A recipe: tools/fetch_bot.py WillyT
bots.ZZZKBot: Zerg 4-pool specialist, AIIDE 2017 champion but easy to defend against now; 32% in your old table. Not in this repository
bots.ComputerTerran: StarCraft's built-in computer AI, the 1500 reference. OpenBW cannot run it
bots.ComputerProtoss: StarCraft's built-in computer AI, the 1500 reference. OpenBW cannot run it
bots.ComputerZerg: StarCraft's built-in computer AI, the 1500 reference. OpenBW cannot run it

bots.UAlbertaBotProtoss: UAlbertaBot playing Protoss; 28% in your old table. Not in this repository
bots.UAlbertaBotTerran: UAlbertaBot playing Terran; 26% in your old table. Not in this repository
bots.UAlbertaBotZerg: UAlbertaBot playing Zerg; 16% in your old table. Not in this repository
bots.BunkerBoxer: 4% in your old table. Not in this repository
